sources.quoteId: POST /audio/translations: deprecated: true, and its description: 'The endpoint and model are deprecated and scheduled to shut down on February 26, 2027. Migrate to /v1/realtime/translations, which requires a separate integration.'

notes.migration: OpenAI removes POST /v1/audio/translations from the API on 2027-02-26, whatever the model. Every audio.translations.create call fails after that date. OpenAI recommends v1/realtime/translations, a realtime API that needs a separate integration rather than one request with a file, so moving needs a person and nothing is rewritten.
edgeCases: Found: every audio.translations.create call in JavaScript and Python, on a client such as client, this.client or AsyncOpenAI(), including with_raw_response and with_streaming_response in Python, whatever the model or however the options are built.
Not found: raw HTTP calls to /v1/audio/translations, a translations or audio object held in its own variable first, and calls made through other libraries such as LangChain.
The endpoint takes only whisper-1, so a call that names it is also reported by openai:2026-08-26:transcription-models-shut-down, which retires that model on the same date.
